messages:
incident-bot: Paging rotation for oncall sam: High error rate detected on /v1/generate — sustained 5xx spike (8.6% over 5m) in us-west. Metric tag=prefix-cache-heartbeat-fail. Please acknowledge.

sam (oncall): ack. pulling up dashboards and logs. what service is spiking?

incident-bot: Sources: runtime-proxy, prefix-cache sharded layer, router. Top error: 502 gateway / heartbeat timeouts. Alerts created: INC-1289.

sam (oncall): grafana link: https://grafana.internal/d/xyz/prefix-cache?orgId=1

olivia: I'm seeing prefix-cache shard metrics dropping heartbeat_ok to 0 on prefix-11 and prefix-18. eviction rate normal. TTLs look fine.

diego: can we get a health endpoint response from the cache-admin? run:
```
curl -sS http://cache-admin.usw1.internal/shard/11/health
```

sam (oncall): ran it, returned 500 with stacktrace:
```
{"error":"heartbeat timeout waiting for metadata sync","shard":"11","uptime":"48h"}
```

maria: Any recent deploys to prefix-cache? I'm checking release log.

kevin: No deployments in the last 6 hours. There was a config change to the heartbeat interval yesterday from 2s -> 3s for perf experiments (PR #4321) — rollback candidate.

ashley: customer impact: streaming generation calls failing with 502 and intermittent 504s. Top impacted customers: acme-llm-prod and travelmate (we've opened CS tickets).

sam (oncall): Running a quick probe across shards: prefix-11,13,18 show heartbeat errors. Others healthy.

sre-bot: Suggested mitigation: 1) disable prefix-cache read path for affected shards, 2) fallback to cold-read from primary KV store, 3) increase heartbeat timeout temporarily. Risk: increased p99 latency and cost.

sam (oncall): I'm going to disable read routing to prefix-11 and prefix-18 in the router. Command:
```
routerctl set-route --service=prefix-cache --shard=11 --mode=fallback
routerctl set-route --service=prefix-cache --shard=18 --mode=fallback
```

olivia: done. router shows fallback active. Monitoring now.

sam (oncall): Within 2m after fallback we see 5xx rate drop from 8.6% -> 1.5%. p95 latency rose 80ms. Streaming sessions reconnecting.

ashley: notifying CS: \"We have activated a fallback to bypass affected cache shards; errors reduced. Some latency increase expected. Team is continuing rollback investigation.\"

kevin: I'm rolling back the heartbeat interval change to 2s on the cache control plane for us-west. Patch: revert PR #4321.

kevin: rollback applied to shards. Waiting for leader reconciliation.

sre-bot: reprobe: health for shard-11 now returns 200 but with WARN: metadata lag 1.2s.

sam (oncall): Good. Initiating gradual re-enable of read routing for shard-11 only.

olivia: re-enable command:
```
routerctl set-route --service=prefix-cache --shard=11 --mode=primary
```

sam (oncall): Re-enabled shard-11. 5xx stable. Re-enable scheduled for shard-18 after 5m observation.

maria: preparing incident post and customer-impact summary. Current status: mitigated -> partial (fallback active for shard-18).

ashley: CS update sent. Tickets: CS-8732 (acme), CS-8733 (travelmate).

diego: root cause hypothesis: increased heartbeat interval exposed a timing window where leader election/metadata sync could exceed timeout under load; triggered heartbeat failures and the runtime proxy returned 502s.

kevin: action items: revert config PR (done), add canary flag for heartbeat interval changes, improve shard health alert to include metadata-lag metric, automate fallback to cold-read for heartbeat_fail tag.

sam (oncall): handing off to diego and kevin for post-incident RCA. Oncall rotation: next is olivia at 19:00 UTC. I'm available for questions. /cc @sre

incident-bot: Incident INC-1289 status -> mitigated. Handoff: diego, kevin. Please update when you close.

maria: will draft the incident summary and include timeline. assigning follow-ups to kevin (config safety), diego (postmortem), and olivia (monitoring rule).

ashley: thanks team :thumbsup:

sre-bot: Suggested postmortem tags: prefix-cache, heartbeat, fallback, customer-impact
